rationale: Retain the official FRED-MD AMBSL-to-BOGMBASE transition. The relationship is non-exact because AMBSL is seasonally adjusted whereas BOGMBASE is not seasonally adjusted and the source/construction changes. C3 and C4 show weaker full-history direct comparability but substantially stronger near-transition comparability. AMBNS triangulation provides strong auxiliary support for BOGMBASE while confirming that seasonal-adjustment and construction differences contribute to the observed break. AMBNS remains auxiliary evidence and is not substituted for AMBSL as the historical FRED-MD predecessor.

Accept the documented PPIFCG-to-WPSFD49502 successor mapping. C3 and full-overlap C4 diagnostics show very strong transformed comparability. Near-transition diagnostics show some localized divergence, consistent with a non-exact transition. The documented BLS change from Stage of Processing to Final Demand-Intermediate Demand aggregation warrants treating the mapping as a methodological successor rather than numerical identity.

Accept the documented PPIFGS-to-WPSFD49207 successor mapping. C3 and full-overlap C4 diagnostics show very strong transformed comparability. Near-transition diagnostics are somewhat weaker than the full-history relationship but remain consistent with a documented non-exact continuation. The BLS SOP-to-FD-ID methodology change prevents treatment as an exact identity.

Accept the documented PPIITM-to-WPSID61 successor mapping. C3, full-overlap C4 and near-transition diagnostics support strong transformed comparability. The BLS SOP-to-FD-ID aggregation change is a genuine methodological difference, so the continuation is accepted as non-exact.

Accept the documented PPICRM-to-WPSID62 successor mapping. C3, full-overlap C4 and near-transition diagnostics provide very strong support for continuity in transformed space. The BLS SOP-to-FD-ID aggregation change remains a methodological difference, so the relationship is classified as non-exact.

Accept the documented FRED-MD TWEXMMTH-to-TWEXAFEGSMTHx splice. C3, full-overlap C4 and near-transition diagnostics show exceptionally strong transformed continuity. The relationship is nevertheless non-exact because FRED-MD constructs the x series by splicing/rebasing the old and revised Federal Reserve dollar indexes, whose weighting methodology, composition and index base changed.
